title: Stalk of a tensor product of modules on a ringed space
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], let $\mathcal F$ and $\mathcal G$ be sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and let $x\in X$. There is a canonical isomorphism of $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-modules $$(\mathcal F\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal G)_x\;\xrightarrow{\sim}\;\mathcal F_x\otimes_{\mathcal O_{X,x}}\mathcal G_x,$$ natural in $\mathcal F$ and $\mathcal G$.

proof.text: Use the direct presheaf comparison [lem-pc-presheaf-module-stalk-tensor] for F.val and G.val. On presheaf modules define the stalk functor over the commutative stalk ring using the underlying additive stalk map; its linearity is checked on scalar and vector germs on a common neighborhood. This agrees with the given sheaf stalk functor on sheaves.

proof.text: Let θ be the sheafification unit followed by the inverse tensorObjIsoSheafification. The underlying abelian stalk map of the unit is invertible by stalkFunctor_map_unit_toSheafify_isIso, and forgetting scalars reflects isomorphisms. The other factor is the stalk image of an isomorphism, so θ_x is invertible. Compose θ_x inverse with the presheaf comparison. The germ formula follows from stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply and cancellation of θ_x with its inverse.

proof.text: Identify θ with the tensorator of the right-adjoint lax monoidal forgetful functor. Tensorator naturality gives (f.val tensor g.val) ≫ θ′ = θ ≫ forget(f tensor g). Apply the presheaf stalk functor and cancel θ_x. The remaining equality is checked on germs of section tensors, using exists_germ_eq and tensor induction. On pure tensors it is the presheaf comparison germ formula, tensor map_tmul, and stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply.
